title: Kind of Low End Quality
text: Kind of Low End Quality. A bit disappointed in this product. I have had other items from this manufacturer that were to notch. This is sort of yard sale quality. It is not long enough or deep enough to be of any benefit in my cabinets. I suppose if you have smaller spaces it would be great. It just isn't wide enough front to back and you lose space because of that. Easy to adjust for the height, but doesn't seem sturdy enough to me to hold much weight. Hard plastic shelf that seems very susceptible to cracking. All in all I would not purchase this.
